_doc: THE SECOND SIGNED RECORD OF THE 2026-09-18 CONTENT-COHERENCE ORDER, beside docs/shift-records/2026-09-18-content-coherence.json and deliberately NOT folded into it: that record has had its act, and a record is never edited after one, only joined by a new record that says what moved next. NO BYTE HAS MOVED FOR THIS ONE: `odqRow` is blank, so tests/helpers/goldenRecordDoor.js refuses it with BLANK_PROVENANCE and both surfaces stand at the bytes the first act left. The chair writes the § row and cites it. ⛔ THE SAME TWO GATES AS BEFORE STAND BETWEEN THIS RECORD AND ITS ACT: espionage-dormancy-fence refuses its own movement as a STOP outside a named chartered window, and the fence hash below was measured on the LANE's tree - the chair re-measures on the consist and uses that figure, because the constant is written from the tree the act runs in.
cause: THE PRESSURE SENTENCES STOPPED MAKING A PLURAL COMMODITY THE SUBJECT OF A SINGULAR VERB. A famine hook shipped reading "Xu Huang, the Mayor, knows where the hoarded medicinal herbs is, and isn't saying" - on the Overview, the DM Summary and Table View at once, because all three read the one generated `pressureSentence`. THE DEFECT IS A CLASS, NOT A LINE, and it is cured whole: `deriveTradeCommodity` returns a bare label with no number on it, four of its fifteen are plural (`gems`, `crafts`, `spices`, `medicinal herbs`) and the first-word fallback can return others, so ANY template that makes `${r.commodity}` the subject of a number-sensitive verb is wrong for a quarter of the corpus. src/generators/narrativeText.js carried exactly three: `famine` index 2 ("knows where the hoarded X **is**" -> "can be found"), `mass_migration` ("The X that made N worth coming to **is** now straining" -> "cannot keep pace with") and `wartime`'s winning branch ("the X **has** never been dearer" -> "never came dearer"). All three become invariant clauses rather than agreeing ones, because there is no plural flag to read and adding one would put a grammar field on the generated object to serve prose; the pool now carries the rule in a comment so the next author writes `the ${r.commodity} reserves` or `every ${r.commodity} cache` - the shapes the surrounding templates already use - instead of a bare subject. A sweep of every `${r.commodity}` site in the file confirms no bare-commodity subject verb remains. MEASURED, single-variable, against the lane tip 903d11ad2 which carries every earlier car: 36 OF 525 ROWS MOVE on generator-golden-master, over exactly ONE PATH TEMPLATE, $.pressureSentence, 36 changes over 36 rows and 33 distinct substitutions - every one the same clause swap under a different NPC name - by tier thorp 12, hamlet 12, village 12 and nothing above a village, because only the small tiers draw the famine pressure sentence in this corpus. Zero structural movement: no roster, no faction, no array-length move, no rng draw; the 525-key set is identical. ⭐ THE TWO SIBLING TEMPLATES COST NOTHING, AND THAT WAS MEASURED RATHER THAN ASSUMED: applied and censused on their own they move 0 ADDITIONAL rows, because the `mass_migration` and `wartime` pools are never drawn by this corpus's configurations - so the whole class is cured for the price of the famine line alone, and leaving two known-wrong templates behind would have saved nothing. On espionage-dormancy-fence's own 360-settlement corpus 3 OF 360 ROWS MOVE (thorp 1, hamlet 1, village 1), 360/360 hashes stay distinct, and the constant reads f13df68e5e511cd385473e95307240d5b73659e11f718eaeafc5f69bf060a69e -> 38a26ac1ca7b7e5bb81d9e7795851b57ca32d50f5a36d78b41e564ccd731f196 AT THE LANE'S TIP; the chair re-measures on the consist before the act and writes that figure, since the two trees differ by whatever else the consist carries. WHAT DID NOT MOVE, measured rather than assumed: the dossier-prose manifest, the mission and rider fences, the PDF golden view model, the four NPC dormancy goldens, the base-state capsule and the golden-freeze walker are green at this tip, and so are the lighting census, the institution walkers, the prose-numerics baseline and the mutation-coverage manifest.
